title: qos/01000ms.png re-blessed despite being a no-strain frame that should be pixel-identical to base
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/qos/01000ms.png b/goldens/qos/01000ms.png
index 5ce1443..9d269e9 100644
Binary files a/goldens/qos/01000ms.png and b/goldens/qos/01000ms.png differ
detail: PR scope states the 01000ms.png is a NO-strain frame (early qos pre-saturation) whose pixels should be unchanged from base; documented re-bless causes cover only the hash fold, per-tick hash bytes, and the 65 s capture. This 1 s frame shift is unaccounted.
recommended_fix: Restore the base 01000ms.png, or extend the re-bless cause documentation to explain exactly which pixels legitimately change in the 1 s no-strain frame.
